name: Relay Dish
description: A tilted pre-Cataclysm satellite dish that still points at an empty sky.
role: A landmark of the old network over the Overgrown Ruins, drawn above the entities that walk under it.

artBrief.silhouette: Wide dish on a thin mast, tilted to one side.
artBrief.detail: Blue panels on the dish face and grey struts behind it.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Blue #4573ed and #7d9bf3, light greys #d7d7d7 and #aeaeae, black outline.
